mentions.name: Schema-driven test data generator
mentions.description: This tooling takes a JSON Schema and generates data compliant with it, used for cases such as creating testing accounts with clean data on non-production environments.
mentions.problem: Tooling for generating schema-compliant data is underdeveloped.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been doing some JSON schema work on our products recently, especially trying to take a schema and generate info compliant with the schema for e.g. testing accounts with clean data on non-production environments, etc. I feel like the area's underdeveloped.
